description: Written by the Config GUI on a working machine, read HEADLESS by the Phoenix boot side. Lives at the Ventoy exFAT partition root next to autounattend.xml. OS-agnostic: no OS-specific keys at top level; platform discriminates, platform-specific bits nest under platform_options. Normative rules the JSON Schema cannot express live in docs/CONFIG-SCHEMA.md §6 and are enforced by tools/Validate-UsbConfig.py.

backup_target.description: Where the Backup phase writes the verified disk image.

kind.description: direct-usb: image to a second direct-attached USB drive (air-gapped, runbook default). castle-smb: push the image to Castle storage over SMB (PROVISIONAL — share path pending founder answer).

label_prefix.description: Prefix for the image folder/file name, e.g. QUARANTINE-INFECTED for suspect machines.

smb_path.description: Castle SMB share for the image, e.g. //castle.lan/images. PROVISIONAL placeholder — founder has not confirmed the share. Required when kind is castle-smb.

boot_entries.description: Toggles for the founder's four boot menu entries. The GUI stages ISOs (and Ventoy aliases) only for enabled entries; the boot side ignores disabled ones.

analyze.description: SystemRescue — inspect without booting the suspect OS.

backup.description: Rescuezilla — verified full-disk image before anything destructive.

nuke.description: ShredOS/nwipe — disk sanitization. DANGEROUS. Requires target_disks allowlist + image-proof gate (see safety).

generated_by.description: Free-text provenance: which GUI/tool wrote this file and when. informational only.

platform.description: OS to install. windows today; linux reserved for a future blade.

safety.description: Nuke safety flags. Read headless by the boot side; the nuke tool must fail closed if any required flag is missing.

abort_countdown_seconds.description: Seconds between arming and execution (Ctrl-C aborts). 0 disables (VM tests only).

allow_skip_image_gate.description: Whether the --skip-image-gate escape hatch (typed NUKE WITHOUT BACKUP on a real TTY) exists at all. Default false = the hatch is compiled out of this stick.

require_image_proof.description: Runbook invariant 1: nuke refuses without a valid image-proof manifest whose source_serial matches the target. MUST be true whenever boot_entries.nuke is true (enforced, see docs §6).

schema_version.description: Config schema version. Bump on any breaking change; readers must reject unknown major versions.

target_disks.description: ALLOWLIST of disk serials the Nuke phase may target. The boot-side nuke tool refuses any disk whose serial is not listed here (in addition to its runtime serial-typing interlock). Empty list = no disk may be nuked. Serials are copied verbatim from the enumeration table — never hand-typed from memory.

model.description: Human label for the operator (cosmetic only).

note.description: Why this disk is on the allowlist.

serial.description: Disk serial as reported by lsblk/smartctl (uppercased, whitespace trimmed).

unattend.description: Answer-file wiring for the Reinstall phase.

answer_file.description: Path on the USB (root-relative) of the answer file consumed by Ventoy auto_install. Generated from this config by the GUI.

title: phoenix-config.json — Phoenix USB OS-agnostic config
